strategic_capability_mapping.relationship: The Rust runtime revalidates AccessNetwork permission at the final real-provider task.run execution boundary.
Strict OpenAI-compatible task.run can contact a provider only when provider guards and current runtime network permission both pass.
Network permission decisions are recorded as bounded PermissionChecked and PermissionDenied evidence without raw prompt, request, provider, key, or header data.
Headless callers receive deterministic runtime-owned admission or denial before external provider network side effects.

answers.strategic_capabilities: Advances runtime_permission_enforcement with supporting llm_provider_execution, persistent_structured_ledger, and headless_autonomous_development.
answers.new_capability: Strict real-provider task.run can execute only after current AccessNetwork mode permission passes.
answers.why_existing_functionality_is_insufficie: BROWNIE_LLM_ALLOW_TASK_RUN_NETWORK and provider configuration authorize process/provider state, but not the stored task mode policy at the final network side-effect boundary.
answers.product_gap_if_skipped: Configured real-provider task.run could still reach external provider execution from a mode that lacks runtime network permission.
answers.non_duplicative: Yes. M14.1 and M14.2 added transaction mutation/recovery, M15.1 hardened WriteWorkspace apply permission, and M13.3 hardened retry provenance rather than AccessNetwork permission.
answers.no_new_rpc: Yes. The existing task.run RPC is hardened.
answers.no_new_summary: Yes. The phase uses existing bounded permission and provider failure evidence tied to actual admission behavior.
answers.runtime_behavior_change: Denied AccessNetwork permission fails closed before real-provider request evidence or external provider execution.
answers.headless_autonomous_contribution: Autonomous controllers can trust Rust-owned permission enforcement before provider network side effects.
answers.milestone_progress: Adds a second major final-use permission boundary after apply-time WriteWorkspace, materially advancing M15 toward closeout.

guard_engine_change_review.review_intent: M15.2 updates the deterministic current phase manifest. Review must confirm real provider network permission denial behavior, not a permission report or guard-only phase.

exit_criteria: Strict OpenAI-compatible task.run revalidates AccessNetwork before real-provider execution
Denied AccessNetwork prevents provider request events and external provider hits
Allowed AccessNetwork mode remains compatible with strict OpenAI-compatible mock provider success
LLM provider failure retry task.run also enforces AccessNetwork after retry provenance revalidation
Fake provider task.run remains compatible with modes that do not allow AccessNetwork

Permission evidence is bounded and excludes raw prompts, provider responses, request bodies, API keys, Authorization or Bearer values, stdout, stderr, commands, environment values, file content, absolute paths, and canonical paths
No new RPC, readiness report, digest, history, preview, inspection surface, shell, git, service, workspace mutation, or live-provider CI dependency is added

runtime_tokens: real-provider task.run requires AccessNetwork runtime permission
